_doc: First / third person framing per view class (ViewClass.java). SINGLE SOURCE: read by ViewClass (ADS maths, hip cant) and by tools/modelgen/display.py, which writes the display transforms of every models/item/<gun>.json. After editing run: python tools/modelgen/display.py. Units as in item model JSON (rotation deg, translation 1/16 block).

RIFLE._note: Tuned in game on the M4 and M2010.

PISTOL._note: Tuned in game on the M17 / Glock 17 / Glock 19 (autotest tour): held out nearer the centre than a shouldered rifle (origin ~0.15 blocks right) and a little higher, clear of the hotbar; third person the grip sits in the two-handed crossbow-hold fists.

HEAVY._note: Starting values (not yet tuned in game): rifle framing carried lower.

DEVICE._note: Handheld drones and two-handed controller. Shared low, central framing set for the controller (Y raised 3.3 -> 5.3 so its screen clears the hotbar and hearts at 1280x720 / GUI scale 3). The drones' item animation shrinks them (drone bone scale) and carries them low on the right (tools/modelgen/drones.py finish_drone). Controller screen faces the eye in its authored rest pose. Preview-checked values; no in-game tuning.

GRENADE._note: Hand grenades (models: tools/modelgen/grenades.py; the grenade's centre of mass is the model origin). Starting values, not yet tuned in game. First person: the grenade sits in the right fist low and right of centre (origin ~0.30 right, 0.16 below, 0.42 in front of the eye), the left hand beside it for the pin. Third person: upright in the fist like a small item (rotation X 90 turns the model's up along the arm).
